text.title: Text
text.intent: Text colour. `primary` for headings and body, `secondary` for supporting copy, `tertiary` for hints and meta, `placeholder` in inputs, `brand` / `link` for links and highlights, `on-brand` on brand fills, `error` · `warning` · `success` for status text.

background.title: Background
background.intent: Surface fills. `primary` for the page and cards, `secondary` for sections and table headers, `tertiary` / `quaternary` for subtle fills and placeholders, `brand-solid` for primary buttons, `brand-subtle` for selected and tinted areas, `*-subtle` / `*-solid` for status, `overlay` behind modals, `inverse` for tooltips.

border.title: Border
border.intent: Strokes. `secondary` for cards and dividers, `primary` for inputs and outlined controls, `brand` for selected, `focus` for focus rings, `error` · `warning` · `success` for status.

foreground.title: Foreground
foreground.intent: Icons and graphics. Same roles as Text.

components.title: Component tokens
components.intent: Used inside Atomus components (buttons, badges, alerts). Use them only when you build the matching component yourself — otherwise use the component.
